fieldErrors.out_of_range: That number is outside the allowed range.
fieldErrors.reserved: That name is reserved. Pick another.

link.copyManually: Couldn't copy for you. The link is selected: copy it yourself.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Everyone with an account on this server.
users.resetPending: Has a reset link that wasn't used yet

makeAdmin.title: Make {{username}} an admin?
makeAdmin.body: Admins can change every setting, manage every account and read the audit log. Enter your password to confirm.

removeAdmin.title: Remove {{username}} as admin?
removeAdmin.body: {{username}} keeps the account, as a member.
removeAdmin.bodySelf: You keep your account, as a member, and lose these admin pages right away.

disable.title: Disable {{username}}?
disable.body: {{username}} is signed out everywhere and can't log in until you enable the account again.

reset.title: Create a reset link for {{username}}?
reset.body: {{username}}'s password stops working right away and they are signed out everywhere. The link lets them choose a new password.
reset.bodyAdmin: {{username}} is an admin, so enter your password to confirm.
reset.linkHint: Copy it now and send it to {{username}} privately. It is shown only once and works until {{expires}}.
reset.linkHintNoExpiry: Copy it now and send it to {{username}} privately. It is shown only once.

signOut.title: Sign {{username}} out everywhere?
signOut.body: Every browser and app where {{username}} is signed in is signed out. They can log in again.

delete.title: Delete {{username}}?
delete.body: The account is removed for good and its username becomes free. This can't be undone.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: People who asked for an account. Approve the ones you know.
approvals.emptyOtherMode: No sign-ups are waiting. People can only ask for an account while registration is set to "Invite, or ask an admin". Open Settings

rejectAll.title: Reject all pending sign-ups?
rejectAll.body: Anyone who is real can sign up again.

invites.title: Invites
invites.lead: An invite link lets a friend create an account on this server.
invites.leadMember: Your invite links. Each lets a friend create an account on this server.
invites.closed: Registration is closed, so invite links don't work right now.
invites.closedAdmin: Registration is closed, so invite links don't work right now. Open Settings

create.title: New invite link
create.noteHint: Optional, and only for you: who the link is for.

created.title: Invite link created
created.label: Invite link
created.hint: Copy it now and send it to your friend. It is shown only once: if it gets lost, create a new one.

invites.showInactive: Show invites that no longer work ({{count}})

revoke.name: Revoke the invite "{{name}}"
revoke.title: Revoke this invite?
revoke.body: The link stops working right away. Accounts that were created with it stay.

invites.emptyActive: No invite link works right now.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.lead: Friends see a room list once there is more than one room.
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.nameHint: Up to {{max}} characters. Emoji are fine.

delete.name: Delete {{name}}
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The room is removed for everyone. This can't be undone.
delete.bodyLive_one: {{count}} person is in it right now. They move to the default room, and what is shared in this room ends.
delete.bodyLive_other: {{count}} people are in it right now. They move to the default room, and what is shared in this room ends.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Changes apply right away, without a restart.

serverName.label: Server name
serverName.hint: Friends see it when they log in and on their invite. Leave it empty to use the server's address.

invite.name: Invite only
invite.hint: Friends join with an invite link.

approval.name: Invite, or ask an admin
approval.hint: Invite links work. Anyone else can ask for an account from the login page, and an admin approves each request.

closed.name: Closed
closed.hint: Nobody can create an account. Invite links stop working until you change this back.

inviteDefaultTtlHours.label: Invite links expire after (hours)
inviteDefaultTtlHours.hint: {{min}} to {{max}}. New invite links start with this.

inviteDefaultMaxUses.label: Uses per invite link
inviteDefaultMaxUses.hint: {{min}} to {{max}}. New invite links start with this.

membersCanInvite.label: Members can create invite links
membersCanInvite.hint: Each member sees only their own links and can have 10 that work at a time.

limits.title: Limits
limits.lead: Optional. isshoni sets no limits of its own.

maxShareBitrateKbps.label: Share bitrate cap (kbps)
maxShareBitrateKbps.hint: {{min}} to {{max}}, or 0 to let each quality preset decide.

transferAlertGb.label: Monthly transfer alert (GB)
transferAlertGb.hint: Admins get an alert when what the server sent in a month passes 80% and 100% of this. 0 turns the alert off.

minClientVersion.label: Oldest app version allowed
minClientVersion.hint: A version such as 0.2.0. Older apps are asked to update. Leave it empty for no minimum.

updateCheck.label: Check for new isshoni releases
updateCheck.hint: Once a day the server asks GitHub for the list of isshoni releases, and the dashboard shows when a newer one is out. The request carries only this server's isshoni version.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Logins and admin actions of the last 30 days, newest first.

filter.label: Filter the log
filter.byTarget: Show only what was done to {{name}}

audit.emptyFiltered: Nothing in the log matches these filters.

auth.throttled: Slowed down after too many attempts

user.password_reset_completed: Chose a new password with a reset link

device.refresh_reused: Unlinked an app after its sign-in was reused
